info.title: Pantheon API
info.description:
Client API for Pantheon, Genau AI's forecasting and dispatch platform for solar + battery plants and battery fleets in Mexico.
It serves everything the Pantheon screens show, so a client's own systems, a lender's advisor or a white-label partner
can use the same data.

**Authentication.** Send your key in `X-API-Key`. Each key belongs to a person with a role:

| Role | Can |
|---|---|
| viewer | Read plans, settlement, reports, alerts |
| auditor | Viewer + audit log + raw forecast CSV (for a lender's technical advisor) |
| operator | Viewer + overrides, approvals, offer export, alert decisions |
| asset_manager | Operator + sign off soft limit breaches, maintenance, disputes, audit log |
| admin | Everything, including operating limits, roles and webhooks |

**Guardrails.** Every plan is checked against the site's limits, outside the forecasting engine. *Hard* breaches (power,
battery charge) can never be approved. *Soft* breaches (daily cycle limit, an uncovered likely critical hour) need an asset
manager's sign-off.

**Capacity value.** Likely critical hours come with a likelihood. Capacity value is always `status: "projection"` with a null
amount until it is verified against CENACE settlement data for the node.

**Daily replay.** `GET /v1/sites/{id}/replay/{date}` answers "did it earn its fee yesterday?": planned against actual, hour by hour,
against the battery sitting idle, with what drove the difference.

**CENACE.** Pantheon never submits to CENACE or controls the battery. An approved plan is an *offer*:
`GET /v1/sites/{id}/offer/{date}` and its `/export` give [TRADER] (the client's Market Participant) the self-schedule to
submit to the day-ahead market by 10:00 on D-1; `/offer/{date}/submitted` records the confirmation; `/cleared/{date}` stores
CENACE's result and the deviations; `/imports/meter` and `/imports/statement` take the meter intervals and the settlement
statements; `/data-sources` says where every number comes from. Lifecycle: offered → cleared → dispatched → measured → settled.

**WhatsApp.** The morning plan and incidents go out as WhatsApp messages with buttons. A tap arrives at
`POST /v1/channels/whatsapp/inbound` from a verified number, runs with that person's role and is written to the audit log with the
channel. Plans that need a sign-off can only be approved in the app.

**Language.** Send `Accept-Language: es-MX` for Spanish messages, explanations and alerts. Field names and codes stay in English.

**Errors.** Always `{"error": {"code", "message", "details"}}`.

**Units.** MXN, MXN/MWh, MW (positive = discharge, negative = charge), MWh, plant local time (America/Mexico_City).

**Product lines.** `GET /v1/products` lists the nine lines Genau offers in Mexico (battery optimization, plant
forecasting, critical-hour service, supplier and trader forecasts, white-label, bankability, revenue floors, grid forecasting,
Genau Mexico with QEnergy); `GET /v1/products/{id}` adds sample figures for its screen. `GET /v1/business/plan` is the
internal 2030 revenue build, admin only.

**Sample data.** This build runs on a sample engine and a demo clock (08:15, Saturday 17 October 2026). Responses carry
`sample_data: true` until the live engine is connected.

critical_hours_caught.title: Critical Hours Caught
critical_hours_caught.description: Null until the live forward test reports.

options.title: Options
options.description: Decisions this alert accepts, if any.

choice.title: Choice
choice.description: One of the alert's options, or 'acknowledge'.

sign_off.title: Sign Off
sign_off.description: Required from an asset manager when the battery state is modelled (no EMS reading).

soc_model.title: Soc Model
soc_model.description: {"value", "band": [low, high]} when the state is modelled.

annual_value_mxn.title: Annual Value Mxn
annual_value_mxn.description: Null until verified against CENACE settlement for this node.

battery_available_mw_in_flagged_hours.title: Battery Available Mw In Flagged Hours

cleared_mw.title: Cleared Mw
cleared_mw.description: Net export MW per hour as cleared by CENACE.

margin_impact.title: Margin Impact
margin_impact.description: MXN, at the frozen price forecast, wear included.

critical_likelihood.title: Critical Likelihood
critical_likelihood.description: Chance this hour is confirmed critical by CENACE.

day.title: Day
day.description: The day the meter file covers. Null for a statement file (its rows carry dates).

export_cap_mw.title: Export Cap Mw
export_cap_mw.description: Maximum net export allowed by the interconnection contract. Offers are clipped to it.

pml_limit_mxn.title: Pml Limit Mxn
pml_limit_mxn.description: Only charge from the grid below this price (MXN/MWh), when grid charging is allowed with a limit.

storage_registered.title: Storage Registered
storage_registered.description: Battery parameters registered with CENACE as part of the unit.

whatsapp_number.title: Whatsapp Number
whatsapp_number.description: Your own verified WhatsApp number, in full.

digest_time_local.title: Digest Time Local
digest_time_local.description: When the daily digest goes out.

deadline.title: Deadline
deadline.description: D-1 10:00 America/Mexico_City. PLACEHOLDER: confirm the current MDA deadline.

note.title: Note
note.default: Pantheon does not submit to CENACE or control the battery. [TRADER] submits this self-schedule; CENACE clears and dispatches it.

net_export_mw.title: Net Export Mw
net_export_mw.description: Solar plus battery at the interconnection point. This is what CENACE sees.

wear_cost_per_mwh.title: Wear Cost Per Mwh
wear_cost_per_mwh.description: MXN per MWh discharged, charged against every plan.

critical_flag_threshold.title: Critical Flag Threshold
critical_flag_threshold.description: Likelihood at which an hour is flagged as likely critical.

charging_cost.title: Charging Cost
charging_cost.description: Grid purchases plus solar not sold, valued at the node price.

sources.title: Sources
sources.description: Where each series comes from: dispatched, measured, prices, settlement.

price_forecast.title: Price Forecast
price_forecast.description: MXN/MWh, as forecast when the plan was approved.

cleared_mw.title: Cleared Mw
cleared_mw.description: What CENACE cleared for the hour. Differs from planned_mw on a deviation.

planned_value.title: Planned Value
planned_value.description: MXN the plan expected this hour, against the battery sitting idle.

value_vs_idle.title: Value Vs Idle
value_vs_idle.description: MXN this hour actually added against the battery sitting idle.

confirmed_critical.title: Confirmed Critical
confirmed_critical.description: CENACE confirmed this hour as critical.

fee_mxn.title: Fee Mxn
fee_mxn.description: Pantheon's fee for the day. Null until the commercial terms are set.

solar_mw.title: Solar Mw
solar_mw.description: Co-located solar, if any. Lowers charging cost.

node_id.title: Node Id
node_id.description: CENACE pricing node. Placeholder in sample data.

solar_mw.title: Solar Mw
solar_mw.description: Co-located solar capacity; 0 for standalone batteries.

force.title: Force
force.description: Record a submission after the deadline (late or corrected offer).

whatsapp_masked.title: Whatsapp Masked
whatsapp_masked.description: Verified WhatsApp number, masked. Null if none on file.

amount.title: Amount
amount.description: Null for a line that is still pending settlement.

secret_hint.title: Secret Hint
secret_hint.description: Last 4 characters of the signing secret.

secret_hint.title: Secret Hint
secret_hint.description: Last 4 characters of the signing secret.

secret.title: Secret
secret.description: Shown once. Verify X-Pantheon-Signature (HMAC-SHA256 of the body) with it.

context.title: Context
context.description: {"site_id", "date"} for a plan, or {"alert_id"} for an incident.

to.title: To
to.description: Recipient, masked. Null if you have no verified number.

can_approve_here.title: Can Approve Here
can_approve_here.description: False when the plan needs a sign-off, which only the app can take.
